newsitem.title: MEXICO: Grupo Iusacell names new head -paper.
newsitem.headline: Grupo Iusacell names new head -paper.

text.p: Mexican telephone company Grupo Iusacell SA de CV named Fulvio del Valle to be the new president and director general of the company, daily newspaper Reforma said on Tuesday.
Del Valle said in a statement he would take over the position as of June 10. He is currently director of Motorola Inc in Mexico with Cedetel-Norcel, the paper said.

Bell Atlantic Corp took over management control of Iusacell on Feb. 12 from majority owner Grupo Iusa. The Peralta family holds 48 percent of Iusacell, Bell Atlantic controls 42 percent and the remainder is publicly traded.
Iusacell was not immediately available for comment on the report.
